name: agent-dispatch-codex
description: Codex-native task routing with configurable execution candidates, strong independent review, automatic hooks, and serial primary-agent Git.

interface.shortDescription: Balance execution cost with independent Astra review.
interface.longDescription: Automatically generates project-local agents for retrieval, research, execution, testing, planning, and review. Offers Luna, Terra, Sol, and Astra execution candidates plus unpinned workers for task-specific choices, with independent Astra review defaults. Selects by task ambiguity, context, risk, and total completion cost; verifies material review findings, sends bounded fixes back to writers, and rechecks affected behavior. Preserves explicit user settings, serial primary-agent Git, quiet tool hooks, and bounded concurrency.
